scope: Flat body bytecode executes actual PyFunction frames with bounded operand/iterator fields, common expressions, assignment/return/branch/for/while instructions and original complex/call handlers. Actual contexts, namespaces/cells, binder leases, source guards, compound admission/unwind, logical fees and genuine awaited effects remain. Source-only cache, startup/native/artifact retention and complete-job allocation are real costs; no factory switch, shadow namespace, pooled contexts or fee discount. Common-body work does not complete the broader compiler or PLAN.
acceptance: Require method gains beyond max(2%, retained spread) in both passes, no repeated control timing regression beyond that bound, and no repeated complete-job allocation growth above 0.5%.
